### Investigate the measured SDP.81 MGE W~ route

Historical rule 5: the SDP.81 MGE-20 A100 library W~ steady full-pipeline call (3.786 ms, jit-phase record) was faster than the dense single-JIT full-pipeline call (28.292 ms). The sparse-enabled artifact also contains a dense /full_pipeline_single_jit measurement; that field is not sparse support. No accepted NUFFT selection for other configurations follows.
